description: Invented pilot organisation (retiresafe-pilot.example, reserved .example TLD). Infrastructure output is real Terraform/AWS-provider output against moto; traffic is the real NASA-HTTP Jul+Aug 1995 log, unmodified, attributed to the scenario hosts below.

traffic_log_build: cat NASA_access_log_Jul95 NASA_access_log_Aug95 > nasa_jul_aug_1995.log (sha256 of the .gz sources: Jul 199109ed0f273e095da6ccd5fc9dc4cd8bb58daa06d62135e62090fea9d27488, Aug 14995aed0ba4558ab832613ebea9a3ef2d87cb4297fc67f5694e0032bbb6b788)

traffic.rule: the busiest two-level prefix whose last request is >= 14 days before log end (pilot/scripts/select_traffic.py)
